prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2025-10-30, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2025-10-30):
| Current ratio           | 1.55 |
| Retained earnings       | 22,252M |
| Current liabilities     | 40,141M |
| Current assets          | 62,071M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 23,793M |
| Total liabilities       | 91,085M |
| Total assets            | 114,935M |
| EBIT / operating income | 8,386M |
| Revenue                 | 17,601M |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The company shows solid profitability (EBIT 8,386 on 17,601 revenue) but appreciable leverage (total liabilities ~3.8x equity) and modest liquidity (current ratio 1.55). While cash generation appears healthy, the high leverage and limited equity cushion suggest investment-grade but leaning toward the lower end, compatible with BBB range.

DECISION: BBB
